title: Kabanos Sparkle
description: A light and smoky Italian dish featuring kabanos sausages, reduced in flavor to be raw-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix kabanos sausages, olive oil, minced garlic, and sliced peppers. Toss until well combined.
Transfer the mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil for easy cleanup.
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired to enhance flavor.
Roast in preheated oven for about 20 minutes, flipping sausages halfway through cooking time.
Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly before serving. Optionally top with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately or store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to three days.
